_doc: The fifteen champion modifiers (docs/arch/40-m4-design.md §5.1-5.2). Per modifier: icon (art/ui/foe_marks order), minAl, text (name, effect, minionEffect, answer, tell), the champion form and the minion form (numbers; {"none": true} = the minion carries nothing), and 'marked' effects (telegraphed cells: shape, windup turns, anchor self|target; checked by ModValidator's escapability rule). Percent values are whole numbers; 'armourPct' is an odds-ratio multiplier of 1 + v/100 (41-m4-minor-issues). blacklist: modifiers never rolled together (listed both ways). roleBans: roles that never carry the modifier. traitBans: monster traits (ability keys, tags) that never carry it.

mods.name: Blood-Frenzied
mods.answer: Chill or Slow cancels the haste; fight it in a doorway.

mods.name: Ironhide
mods.answer: Spells, damage over time and Rot go around the iron.

mods.name: Vengeful
mods.effect: Turns 15% of every direct blow back on its striker; it never kills.
mods.minionEffect: Turns 8% of every direct blow back on its striker; it never kills.
mods.answer: Damage over time, traps and summons strike it unpunished.

mods.name: Cursecaster
mods.effect: Every hit lays Weaken for 3 turns.
mods.minionEffect: One hit in four lays Weaken for 3 turns.
mods.answer: Do not be hit: keep range, block, or send thralls in.

mods.name: Vampiric
mods.effect: Drinks back 20% of the damage it deals, thralls included.
mods.minionEffect: Drinks back 10% of the damage it deals.
mods.answer: Blight halves its feeding; pull your thralls back.

mods.name: Plague-ridden
mods.effect: Leaves a 3-turn Blight cloud on every cell it quits.
mods.minionEffect: Bursts into a Blight cloud where it falls.
mods.answer: Step sideways; never walk through its wake.

mods.name: Hoarfrost
mods.effect: Hits Chill; leaves 3-turn frost behind it that Chills whoever steps in.
mods.answer: Do not chase it through the rime; fire melts the trail.

mods.name: Warded
mods.effect: Every resistance raised by 40, to at most 75.
mods.minionEffect: Every resistance raised by 20, to at most 75.
mods.answer: Plain steel and piercing blows ignore the ward.

mods.name: Hungering
mods.effect: Each blow that lands feeds it +10% damage, up to +100%; it sheds one helping per 3 turns unfed.
mods.minionEffect: Each blow that lands feeds it +10% damage, up to +30%.
mods.answer: Starve it: kite, block, hold your thralls back.
mods.tell: swells and reddens; a count on its plate

mods.name: Pyre-touched
mods.effect: Burns whoever stands beside it; two turns after it dies its pyre bursts across two tiles.
mods.minionEffect: Burns whoever stands beside it; a turn after it dies its pyre bursts across one tile.
mods.answer: Finish it, then step away; or fight it from range.

mods.name: Stormcalled
mods.effect: Hits Shock; every 6 turns it calls a storm line toward you.
mods.answer: Sidestep the line, or break its line of sight.

mods.name: Shepherd
mods.effect: Every 8 turns it calls 2 of its kin up from omen cells, 4 alive at most.
mods.answer: Stun the call, and kill the shepherd first.

mods.name: Phasing
mods.effect: Every 5 turns it marks a cell beside you and steps out of the rift there next turn.
mods.answer: Move off and it loses its turn; a trap on the mark greets it.

mods.name: Unstoppable
mods.effect: Cannot be Stunned, Frozen, Feared or Rooted; Slow and Chill still bite.
mods.answer: Dodge every heavy blow and keep your distance.

mods.name: Mirrored
mods.effect: At half Life it splits into two, each with the Life left; only the first pays its due.
mods.answer: Area damage, or burst it through half Life at once.
